4a8756e2.text:
You dial yourself up every morning.

The switch says: what is that hum?

I’m calling for myself. The humming is not my own,

86c6cf41.text: but an echo from some distant world.

c800990f.text: I am not sure how to reach you.

4ddcfa61.text: You do not answer, but there's a sound. A voice,

a8709625.text: a woman with a soft southern lilt, she says

ee169da1.text: I don't know this lady, but I hear her

f1c09029.text: when she is near. I am close enough now that the sound is

63091649.text: faint. When I turn around and face back towards

2a91eda0.text: the house I can see a silhouette standing in the doorway.

e9deef62.text: I cannot make out anything else but it is you, it’s definitely you

e2a597de.text: and your shadow. The woman walks slowly behind the figure and

adc14d56.text: comes forward with her hands stretched out before her.

561daa47.text: You are you. You are my you. My mother. I have found you.

c6aeca7d.text: There is something wrong with the connection.

fde12889.text: There is something wrong with your mind, but

7a4de245.text: I will stay here with you until they come to take you away.

485a9dfc.text: There is a shadow on your left shoulder.

8b8c73eb.text: A small woman who never speaks,

d5b7b2c0.text: When I see the two of you together,
